changes: Raise only the universal release APK ceiling from 230 MiB to 250 MiB for the measured qualified arm64-v8a plus x86_64 native payload, retaining 8,424,218 bytes of bounded headroom.
Keep the arm64-v8a and x86_64 release ceilings at 180 MiB and preserve all signing, runtime, telemetry, checksum, attestation and immutable publication gates.
Add behavior coverage that admits the observed two-ABI package, rejects it one byte below its measured size and verifies both single-ABI ceilings remain unchanged.
limitations: This scoped correction changes an explicit universal-package size policy; it does not reduce package size or establish physical-device performance.

The failed publisher created no release. Android 0.9.66.15 and Gateway 18.1.3 still require all exact-head and exact-main checks, the normal signed joint publisher, and public checksum and attestation verification.
